---
title: "TB40/E PRO-Seq Results"
---

This is a website displaying data for the PRO-Seq experiment performed on TB40/E infected fibroblasts. 
The original data can be found in the [GEO database](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE185763) under accession number GSE185763. 
It was originally described in a preprint by [Ball et al., 2022](https://doi.org/10.3390/v14040779).
